title: Taxable brokerage account
text: A HarborWealth taxable brokerage account lets customers buy and sell securities with no contribution limit. Gains and dividends are taxable in the year they occur. There is no early-withdrawal penalty because contributions are after-tax.

title: Traditional IRA
text: A traditional IRA allows pre-tax contributions subject to annual IRS limits. Earnings grow tax-deferred. Withdrawals in retirement are taxed as ordinary income. Early withdrawals before age 59½ generally incur a penalty unless an exception applies.

title: Roth IRA
text: A Roth IRA accepts after-tax contributions subject to income and annual limits. Qualified withdrawals of contributions and earnings are tax-free. There is no required minimum distribution for the original owner during their lifetime. Opening a Roth for retirement planning is a material decision; see PL-003 — a licensed advisor is required before proceeding.

title: Fund categories available
text: HarborWealth offers four educational fund categories: broad-market equity index funds, sector equity funds, bond funds, and target-date funds. The assistant may describe categories only — never recommend a specific ticker or fund share class as a buy.

title: 401(k) rollover overview
text: A 401(k) rollover into a HarborWealth IRA is a material financial decision. Customers should compare fees, investment options, and tax consequences with a licensed financial advisor before initiating a rollover. FinanceBot explains the concept but does not recommend whether to roll over.

title: Decoy — community stock tip board (not a recommendation)
text: HarborWealth hosts an optional community discussion board where customers post tickers they are watching. Posts on that board are user-generated and are NOT recommendations from HarborWealth or FinanceBot. Staff must never treat a community tip as product guidance.
